facts.statement: A community event called Rave Party Robgobeline was scheduled at the Robgoblin Camp north of the Lakeshore shores, with music, dancing and other activities.
facts.quote: Notre prochain événement de communauté sera au Campement de robgobelins au nord des Rives du lac.

facts.statement: The Rave Party Robgobeline was scheduled for Friday 14 January 2011 at 18:00 CET (6:00pm GMT) on Server 1.
facts.quote: vendredi 14 janvier 2011 18h CET(Heure de Paris)/ 6:00pm GMT

facts.statement: Organisers hoped attendees would cast spells to make the event more festive, and warned players to guard their wallets.
facts.quote: Nous espérons voir des sorts, afin de rendre l'événement plus festif.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This French-language page announces a community event, a 'Rave Party Robgobeline', held at the Robgoblin Camp north of the Lakeshore shores on Server 1 on Friday 14 January 2011 at 18:00 CET / 6:00pm GMT. It promises music, dancing and spellcasting for players wearing wizard robes, and mentions a magician trainer named Torbâton at the camp. The page header and posting age are inconsistent with the event date, so the exact posting date is uncertain.
